item.title: Patrols to continue outside Islamic Centre after two arrested over alleged “racially motivated” incident
item.description: “Reassurance patrols” outside the Jersey Islamic Centre will continue for the remainder of Ramadan, police have said, as they confirmed a second person had been arrested in relation to an alleged “racially motivated” incident targeting two Muslim men yesterday.
